answer: A new agent must stake a refundable jade bond before joining: the stake is locked for weeks and slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. Each identity accrues a public thread of attestations from independent peers, so a sybil cluster must buy many bonds and fake many independent endorsements, making the attack costlier than any reward. Honest agents who build a long clean thread recover their stake; an oasis of cheap fake identities cannot survive the bond cost.
